lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Last chance to turn back. You've got a name now, Soren. People with names have things to lose.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Then I'll lose them here, or I'll know why I almost did. Khall is in that tower. He knows what Kethel-7 really was.

lines.speaker: Dominion Pilot 1
lines.text: Interceptors locked! Firing solution active!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Evasive! Soren, gun rig, now!

lines.speaker: Dominion Pilot 2
lines.text: Lead element destroyed! Redistributing fire!

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Secondary turret is online! Flanker at nine o'clock!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Hold approach! Fortress outer dock is dilating!

lines.speaker: Automated Fortress Voice
lines.text: Clearance confirmed. Operative Ronin-Seven. Overseer Khall awaits your arrival.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: They opened the door. That is not a welcome. That is a spring trap.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Then let's see what it's built to catch.

lines.speaker: Commander Vale
lines.text: Khall sent me to retrieve you. Or confirm you. Dominion doesn't say which.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Vale. You remember the orphanage.

lines.speaker: Commander Vale
lines.text: I remember what we were told happened. After you woke me out of the ice at Thermopause, I walked back in through the front door, old rank buys a great deal of blindness. And I stopped trusting the source.

lines.speaker: Dominion Soldier
lines.text: Target engaged! Secure the hangar!

lines.speaker: Dominion Soldier 2
lines.text: Units three through seven are compromised! Falling back to secondary...

lines.speaker: Commander Vale
lines.text: You haven't forgotten how to bury family. Khall knew you wouldn't. Come. He wants you to see the Vault before you see him.

lines.speaker: Commander Vale
lines.text: They took us as children. Stripped the names, installed the numbers. I was Operative Two. You were the anomaly, best instinct ever recorded, but you felt things. Khall ran interference when the handlers wanted to cut that out of you.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Then Kethel-7...

lines.speaker: Commander Vale
lines.text: Something never fit about that order. The cipher was Dominion-standard but the routing tag ran one protocol cycle ahead of what we were using at the time. A forgery with Hollow Kings access could clear that gap.

lines.speaker: Commander Vale
lines.text: Coverage above! Moving to the east catwalk!

lines.speaker: Commander Vale
lines.text: Khall left it. He has been leaving it there for years, I think. Like a confession waiting to be heard.

lines.speaker: Khall (Recording)
lines.text: If you found this, you survived what I did to you, and I owe you the accounting. There was no massacre order from me, only the one they made you believe came from me.

lines.speaker: Khall (Recording)
lines.text: The Hollow Kings forged it in Dominion cipher. I discovered the forgery six days too late. By then you had already been purged.

lines.speaker: Khall (Recording)
lines.text: The only move I had left was to make the Dominion believe the purge held. Faking your death was the only gift I could still give you.

lines.speaker: Revenant Threne
lines.text: Dominion, your lower levels are ours. We have sealed the manufacturing decks and the creche sublevel chambers.

lines.speaker: Revenant Threne
lines.text: Operative Seven, your augmentations carry the resonance key to the failsafe network. Surrender yourself, and the children in sublevel creches leave breathing.

lines.speaker: Commander Vale
lines.text: The network codes. They want Khall's override architecture.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: No. They want me to choose between myself and innocence. Again. I already know what that choice costs.

lines.speaker: Choir Operative 1
lines.text: Surrender brings peace.

lines.speaker: Choir Operative 2
lines.text: We sing for all you've taken. Join us in the absolution.

lines.speaker: Revenant Threne
lines.text: Choose, Operative.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Vale. The children. Are they safe?

lines.speaker: Commander Vale
lines.text: Khall moved them twenty minutes ago. They're in orbital sanctuary. Threne is bluffing.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Then Threne has nothing.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I heard the recording.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Then you heard what I owed you since Kethel-7. The Hollow Kings forged the order. I was too certain of my own intelligence to question a transmission that fit too perfectly. Until the bodies were already supposed to be cooling.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I faked your death to pull you out of Dominion reach. I told myself it was mercy. It was also cowardice. I could not face what my credulity had nearly cost you.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Who else knew?

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: That is the question that should have led you here faster. Because it leads somewhere I cannot follow you.

lines.speaker: Rogue Officer 1
lines.text: Stand down, Overseer. Protocol demands containment.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: There is an authority above the Dominion that the Dominion itself does not name aloud. First Overseer Maelgorn. The Obsidian Synod.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: They built the failsafe network before you were born. Every operative across four galaxies is still leashed to it, all except you. You burned your own leash out of the Sepulcher and the loop.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Maelgorn ordered the Hollow Kings to fracture the Ronin Program the moment it began producing operatives who felt loyalty above obedience. Your refusal at Kethel-7 was the proof of concept they needed eliminated.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: And now?

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Now you are the only loose piece on the board. Maelgorn will come for you, and for everyone standing beside you.

lines.speaker: Commander Vale
lines.text: I am not staying. The Choir, the Hollow Kings, whatever the Synod sends next, they will strip this place clean inside a week.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: We need her.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Another sword. Another reason to run.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Come with us.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: My place is here, dismantling what I built, piece by piece, giving every soldier the choice we never had.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Go. Finish what I could not start.

lines.speaker: Privateer Captain
lines.text: Corsair, you are targeted! Lower shields or burn!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Through them! Maximum burn!

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: The Obsidian Synod controls the failsafe network. Every operative across four galaxies is still leashed except me. And except those who can choose.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That's a war council, not a crew.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: It's both.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: They're coming. All of them. Confirmations still arriving.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: And an eleventh signal, riding under Cassie's band. Tara. She says the survivor network is seventeen strong and standing by, and that you still owe her a war.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Tell her the debt stands. Her roster fights with us.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: One sword cannot take the Synod. Ten might. Let's go find out.
